summary.text: Suzanne Wikle is a Democratic member of the Kansas House of Representatives who has represented District 10 since January 2025 and is on the November 3, 2026 general election ballot for re-election.
Ballotpedia lists her profession as policy director.

paragraphs.text: Wikle was born in Kansas City, Missouri, graduated from Shawnee Mission North High School, and earned a bachelor's degree from Washington University in St. Louis and a graduate degree from the University of Kansas in 2006.
Her career experience includes working as a policy director and policy analyst, and as of 2024 she was affiliated with the Community Children's Center and Alliance for a Healthy Kansas.
Wikle assumed office on January 13, 2025, succeeding Christina Haswood.
For the 2025-2026 session she was assigned to the Agriculture, Health and Human Services, and Legislative Modernization committees.
